name: arch-arena
description: HLD Arena — interactive system design learning and challenge platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @arch-arena/server" "npm run dev -w @arch-arena/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @arch-arena/server && npm run build -w @arch-arena/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @arch-arena/shared && npm run test -w @arch-arena/web && npm run test -w @arch-arena/server
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:deploy && npm run db:seed
